messages:
Aisha Kumar: Hey all, quick onboarding question — can I register my personal iPhone for Okta Verify today? My workstation delivery is delayed. Also curious if storing SSH private keys in iCloud Keychain is allowed for short-term dev access.
Morgan (People Ops): Welcome Aisha :wave: You can register Okta Verify on your phone for MFA, but please enable a passcode/biometrics and device encryption first. For laptop/workstation delays we issue a managed loaner; want me to request one?
Aisha Kumar: Yes please on the loaner, that would be great. Is there a specific BYOA/BYOD waiver I should sign for phone MFA?
Jules (Security): Short answers: 1) Okta Verify on phone = allowed for MFA if device meets our baseline (screen lock, disk encryption, OS supported). 2) iCloud Keychain for private SSH keys = not allowed because keys would be synced to personal cloud backups. Use the company-managed credential store or a local encrypted keyring on the loaner.
IT-helpdesk: If you need immediate access we can mint a temporary deploy key tied to your account for 24h. Submit a short ticket with repo name and justification and we'll scope it.
Aisha Kumar: Got it. What's the baseline doc for the phone? I couldn't find the checkbox list.
Morgan (People Ops): Link: https://intranet.redwood/security/byod-baseline — there are the exact checks (passcode, OS min version, full-disk encryption, screen timeout). I'll DM the BYOD waiver (form: BYOD-2026-1). Sign and return and we can mark you as MFA-registered.
Jules (Security): Also, note PhishSim: new hires are exempt for the first 7 days by default, but training "Security Essentials" must be completed within 72h of account creation. security-bot will assign it. If you opt into personal device MFA we still require enrollment in our mobile device registry (it does NOT install an MDM unless it's a company device).
security-bot: Security training assigned: "Security Essentials (Onboarding)" 72h completion window. BYOD waiver template sent to Morgan.
Aisha Kumar: Thanks everyone — Morgan, please file the loaner request. Jules, I'll avoid iCloud for keys and wait for the loaner. One more quick Q: can I use my home Wi-Fi for VPN or do we block connections?
Jules (Security): You can use home Wi-Fi, but enable device firewall and ensure OS patches applied. Avoid public hotspots for initial setup. If you want, IT-helpdesk can provide a USB Ethernet dongle and hotspot profile to reduce issues.
IT-helpdesk: Filed loaner request (ticket #IT-3347). We'll schedule pickup or courier depending on your location.
Aisha Kumar: Amazing, thanks all. I'll complete the training and sign the waiver tonight.
Morgan (People Ops): Welcome aboard again :tada: ping us in DM if anything blocks the loaner pickup or Okta steps.
